status: User-directed implementation guidance; Terra 6.1 High reviewed
goal: Make execution structure clear in the focused Tasks list: sequential rows, expandable parallel branches under their actual root, and readable dependencies.

presentation.root: Use a short recorded plan title for its root lane, or the actual prerequisite task row where it anchors a fork. New plans may carry an optional concise Architect-authored title; legacy plans without one use a quiet short plan reference and keep their full objective in details. A root group is presentation, not a fabricated task. Never display operational handoff instructions as the root title.
presentation.sequential: Keep ordinary rows in stable admitted integration order, with light indentation/connectors where useful. Dependency edges determine relationships; row order alone does not promise execution order.
presentation.parallel: A quiet chevron expands sibling branches beneath their actual root. Keep the existing lifecycle glyph and task title on each child. A shared join returns to the root lane. Disjoint root tasks may share the recorded plan root.
presentation.mixedGraphs: Only fold unambiguous non-overlapping fork/join blocks. Keep each task once; expose cross-dependencies as references instead of forcing a DAG into a false tree.
presentation.scheduling: A branch group describes graph structure. Actual concurrent execution and serialization/wait reasons come from runtime records.
presentation.dependencies: Use a compact dependency indicator on affected rows and concise clickable Waiting on / Blocks references in the selected inspector. References can retrieve completed or filtered-out prerequisites within the same authorized scope.
presentation.focus: Preserve the quiet Linear-influenced list, existing row density, native theme/fonts and lower split inspector. Use topology and selection to expose useful context without a new grouping toolbar or repeated state badges.

interaction.accordion: Separate keyboard-accessible disclosure from row selection. Persist expansion by session/project, plan and stable fork identity. Status updates do not reset it or reorder rows.
interaction.selection: Selecting a child reference reveals its containing group and scrolls/focuses the row when it belongs to the visible view. Keep the lower inspector available for an authorized dependency excluded by the current filter.
interaction.search: Reveal matching descendants temporarily without overwriting the saved collapse preference.
interaction.filtering: Hide completed work by default while retaining enough quiet root/dependency context to understand remaining branches. Group counts identify their active/total scope.
interaction.empty: Planless tasks remain ordinary rows. Missing topology stays ungrouped with honest availability; never infer a complete graph from a partial result page.

contract.reuse: Extend the shared scoped observation projection already tasked as efd8459f-1dbe-4472-968b-f26f59504291.
fields: optional concise authored plan title, with honest legacy reference fallback
task specification revision and stable ordinal
current task states and real wait reasons
contract.paging: QueryOutput is currently flat and paginated. Obtain complete scoped plan topology separately or return graph membership consistently with pagination; PlanInput currently caps a plan at 100 nodes.
contract.authority: Display existing graph and scheduling facts. Folding and selection never change dependencies or dispatch policy.
contract.planTitle: Optional title belongs in the normal versioned PlanInput body; existing revisions remain unchanged. The GUI does not generate summaries or call a model to name groups. Architect supplies concise user-facing titles for new plans.

implementation: Add the needed topology/group data to the shared read projection before UI grouping.
Implement the compact grouped Tasks renderer as a focused increment after the current Start/layout worker is reviewed.

Dogfood a real sequential chain and real parallel branches; verify join/cross-edge handling, filtered prerequisites, search, keyboard disclosure, paging, persisted expansion and narrow-panel behavior with Terra captures.
